messages.message: Do not use `window.location.assign()` to navigate to internal Next.js pages. Use `redirect()` in the render phase, or `useRouter().push()` in Client Components' event handlers instead. See: https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/no-location-assign-relative-destination
Do not use an `<a>` element to navigate to `/`. Use `<Link />` from `next/link` instead. See: https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/no-html-link-for-pages
